description: This PHP class defines data transfer object (DTO) parameters for filtering employee allowed language search results in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes a property for employee number and sorting logic.

classes.name: EmployeeAllowedLanguageSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for encapsulating search filter parameters for employee allowed languages, including sorting and employee identification.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with a default sort field.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter criterion.
